paper_title: SimSMoE Solving Representational Collapse via Similarity Measure
caption: : SMoE Routing Policy

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of two models, labeled as "SMoE Validating" and "SimSMoE Validating", in terms of Bits Per Character (BPC) across varying training steps. The x-axis represents the "Training Steps" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 50 with tick labels at intervals of 10 steps, expressed as 10^3 increments. The y-axis represents "BPC", also on a linear scale, with a range from 1.2 to 2.2, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The black line, representing "SMoE Validating", features a cross marker and a solid line style. It starts at a BPC value of approximately 1.7 at 0 training steps, showing a sharp declining trend till 1.25 at step 10 and leveling off at around 1.1 by 50,000 training steps. The magenta line represents "SimSMoE Validating", and it is characterized by a circle marker and solid line style. This line mirrors a similar trend, starting at around 2.2 BPC at 0 training steps showing a sharp declining trend till 1.25 at step 10, and decreasing to approximately 1.1 BPC by 50,000 steps below black line. Both lines exhibit a steep decline initially and become relatively stable as they progress along the x-axis. A legend is given top right.
